audience: teams reviewing leads and enquiries collected through a Formspree form

useCases.title: Review new enquiries
useCases.text: Choose the columns you need, then read recent submissions with dates and contact details. Follow the returned offset to review further pages.

useCases.title: Check spam for missed enquiries
useCases.text: Review submissions marked as spam to spot messages that may need attention. This reads the spam list without changing its classification.

useCases.title: Inspect the fields in recent submissions
useCases.text: List field names observed in the latest 100 submissions before choosing which columns to read. This returns names rather than submission contents.
